tables.purpose: Grower-level summary imported from Excel; base table for year matrix and detail rows.
View over purchy_grower_summary with calculated keys, loyalty bucket, and dishonour bucket.
2025 indent (purchy issue) fact rows; joined to summary by villagecode+growercode.
2025 supply fact rows; purchasemodeqty parsed from purchasemodename prefix when numeric.
Indent failure (dishonour) fact rows; joined to indent via society purchy number.
Staff hierarchy mapping by village for staff drilldown and staff slicers.
Reference year dimension (2020-2025); not queried directly by dashboard APIs.

rows.name: Total Growers
rows.description: Count of growers in the filtered grower detail set shown in the header across all tabs.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) FROM purchy_grower_summary_v gs {joins} {whereSql}; returned as growerDetail.total from GET grower-performance/detail.
rows.comparison: No % chip (BiKeyMetricBox has no comparison UI)

rows.name: Ttl Growers with Bond
rows.description: Number of growers with a positive bond value for the selected calendar year row.
rows.formula: Per year Y in {2021,2022,2023,2024}: SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(gs.<bondCol>,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Y=2025: bondCol=total_bond; 2024=bond2024; 2023=bond2023; 2022=bond2022; 2021=bond2021. IFNULL to 0; frontend hides year 2020.

rows.name: # Growers with Indent
rows.description: Growers with at least one issued purchy (indent) in the year row.
rows.formula: Per year Y: SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(gs.<indentGrowerCol>,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Historical: indentGrowerCol=issue21..issue24. 2025: no_of_purchy_indent.

rows.name: # Growers Supplied
rows.description: Growers with positive supply quantity in the year row.
rows.formula: Per year Y: SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(gs.<supplyCol>,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Historical: supply_2021..supply_2024. 2025: weight_qty_2025.

rows.name: Ttl Bond
rows.description: Total bonded quota summed across filtered growers for the year row.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(gs.<bondCol>),0). 2025: total_bond; 2024: bond2024; 2023: bond2023; 2022: bond2022; 2021: bond2021.

rows.name: Supply Qty by Year
rows.description: Total supply quantity for the year. 2025 uses fact-table supply qty (parsed purchasemodeqty), not weight_qty_2025.
rows.formula: Historical: IFNULL(SUM(gs.supply_20YY),0). 2025: query2025Facts(ctx).supplyQty = IFNULL(SUM(purchaseModeQty(s)),0) over purchy_supply joined to filtered growers via indent.
rows.source: purchy_grower_summary.supply_2021, supply_2022, supply_2023, supply_2024; purchy_supply.purchasemodename, purchy_supply.purchasemodeqty, purchy_indent.societypurchy_no

rows.name: Supply vs Bond %
rows.description: Supply quantity as a percentage of total bond for the year row.
rows.formula: ttlBondN ? supplyN / ttlBondN : null. Display: null renders as em dash; else (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%".
rows.source: Derived from Ttl Bond and Supply Qty by Year columns above

rows.name: Issued Purchy (cnt)
rows.description: Count of issued purchy (indent) for the year row.
rows.formula: Historical: IFNULL(SUM(gs.issue21|issue22|issue23|issue24),0). 2025: query2025Facts.indentCount = COUNT(*) FROM purchy_indent i INNER JOIN purchy_grower_summary_v gs ON i.villagecode=gs.village_code AND i.growercode=gs.grower_code with filter context.

rows.name: Weighted Purchy (cnt)
rows.description: Count of weighted (supplied) purchy for the year row.
rows.formula: Historical: IFNULL(SUM(gs.wt21|wt22|wt23|wt24),0). 2025: query2025Facts.supplyCount = COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM purchy_supply s INNER JOIN purchy_indent i ON s.societypurchy_no=i.societypurchy_no joined to gs.
rows.source: purchy_grower_summary.wt21, wt22, wt23, wt24; purchy_supply.id, purchy_supply.societypurchy_no

rows.name: Purchy Dishonour (cnt) %
rows.description: Share of issued purchy not weighted (indent minus supply count) over issued count.
rows.formula: issuedN ? (issuedN - weightedN) / issuedN : null. PBI DAX: DIVIDE([Issued Purchy (cnt)]-[Weighted Purchy (cnt)],[Issued Purchy (cnt)],BLANK()). Display: (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%" or em dash when null.
rows.source: Derived from Issued Purchy (cnt) and Weighted Purchy (cnt)

rows.name: Total Bond_2025
rows.description: Per-grower value and paginated table footer total for Total Bond_2025.
rows.formula: gs.total_bond per row; footer SUM(gs.total_bond).

rows.name: Indent Qty_2025
rows.description: Per-grower value and paginated table footer total for Indent Qty_2025.
rows.formula: gs.indent_qty per row; footer SUM(gs.indent_qty).

rows.name: Weight Qty 2025
rows.description: Per-grower value and paginated table footer total for Weight Qty 2025.
rows.formula: gs.weight_qty_2025 per row; footer SUM; displayed with 2 decimal places.

rows.name: Indent Failer Qty
rows.description: Per-grower value and paginated table footer total for Indent Failer Qty.
rows.formula: gs.indent_failer_qty per row; footer SUM(gs.indent_failer_qty).

rows.name: Row count (N total)
rows.description: Total filtered grower rows in the detail table header.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) AS total from same filter context as detail query; displayed as "{total} total" with en-IN locale.

rows.name: Bonded Growers
rows.description: Count of growers in the dishonour tab filter context. PBI measure name Bonded_Growers; SQL counts all filtered summary rows (not bond>0 only).
rows.formula: COUNT(*) FROM purchy_grower_summary_v gs {joins} {whereSql} AND gs.no_of_indent_failer_purchy IS NOT NULL
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Indent Count
rows.description: Count of indent fact rows for filtered growers.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) FROM purchy_indent i INNER JOIN purchy_grower_summary_v gs ON i.villagecode=gs.village_code AND i.growercode=gs.grower_code {joins} {whereSql} AND gs.no_of_indent_failer_purchy IS NOT NULL
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Indent Qty
rows.description: Sum of indent mode quantities for filtered growers.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(i.supllymodeqty),0) with same join/filter as 2025 Indent Count.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Supply Count
rows.description: Distinct supply rows linked to filtered growers via indent purchy number.
rows.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM purchy_supply s INNER JOIN purchy_indent i ON s.societypurchy_no=i.societypurchy_no INNER JOIN gs ...
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Supply Qty
rows.description: Sum of parsed purchase mode quantity from supply rows.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.purchasemodename IS NOT NULL AND LOCATE(' ', s.purchasemodename) > 0 AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.purchasemodename, ' ', 1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.purchasemodename, ' ', 1) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ELSE NULL END),0) alias purchaseModeQtySql(s) in purchyPbiFacts.js
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour Count
rows.description: Count of dishonour fact rows joined to indent and filtered growers.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) FROM purchy_dishonour d INNER JOIN purchy_indent i ON d.society_purchy_no=i.societypurchy_no INNER JOIN gs ...
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour % (Count)
rows.description: Dishonour count divided by indent count.
rows.formula: indentCount ? dishonourCount / indentCount : 0. PBI: DIVIDE([2025_Dishonour Count],[2025_Indent Count],0). Display: (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%".
rows.source: Derived from 2025 Dishonour Count and 2025 Indent Count
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Sum of dishonour mode quantities.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(d.mode_qty),0) with dishonour fact join.
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour % (Qty)
rows.description: Dishonour quantity divided by indent quantity.
rows.formula: indentQty ? dishonourQty / indentQty : 0. PBI: DIVIDE([2025_Dishonour Qty],[2025_Indent Qty],0).
rows.source: Derived from 2025 Dishonour Qty and 2025 Indent Qty
rows.comparison: BiKpiCard comparison chip always shows 0.0% (value=100, pyValue=0 hardcoded); no comparisonLabel; chip visible but non-informative

rows.name: No of Purchy Indent
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: gs.no_of_purchy_indent; footer SUM.

rows.name: No of Indent Failer purchy
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: gs.no_of_indent_failer_purchy; footer SUM. Page filter requires IS NOT NULL.

rows.name: 2025 Supply Count
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: IFNULL(sup.supply_count,0) from per-grower LEFT JOIN subquery COUNT(DISTINCT s.id); footer SUM.

rows.name: 2025 Indent Qty
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: IFNULL(ind.indent_qty,0) per grower; footer SUM(ind.indent_qty).

rows.name: 2025 Supply Qty
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: IFNULL(sup.supply_qty,0) per grower from purchaseModeQtySql; footer SUM.

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column.
rows.formula: IFNULL(dh.dishonour_qty,0) per grower; footer SUM.

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour % (Qty)
rows.description: Per-grower dishonour detail column (rate).
rows.formula: Per row: indentQty ? dishonourQty / indentQty : 0. Footer: indentQtyTotal ? dishonourQtyTotal / indentQtyTotal : 0. Display 2dp %.

rows.name: Row count (N total)
rows.description: Total growers with indent failures matching filters.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) with gs.no_of_indent_failer_purchy IS NOT NULL and slicer filters.

rows.name: # Growers
rows.description: Distinct grower_name_key count in filter context.
rows.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT gs.grower_name_key) FROM purchy_grower_summary_v gs {joins} {whereSql}

rows.name: # Villages
rows.description: Distinct village_name_key count in filter context.
rows.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT gs.village_name_key) FROM purchy_grower_summary_v gs {joins} {whereSql}

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour % (Count) (root)
rows.description: Overall dishonour rate by purchy count for the filtered population.
rows.formula: query2025Facts(ctx).dishonourPctCount = indentCount ? dishonourCount/indentCount : 0. Display: Number(rootPct*100).toFixed(2)+"%".

rows.name: Society_Name node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) for each society in the tree, sorted descending, top 100 with indentCount>0.
rows.formula: query2025FactsGrouped(ctx, "gs.society_name").dishonourPctCount per group; display pct*100 toFixed(2).

rows.name: Village_name_Key node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) per village under selected society.
rows.formula: query2025FactsGrouped with extra WHERE gs.society_name=?; same pct formula per village_name_key.

rows.name: Grower_name_Key node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) per grower under selected society and village.
rows.formula: query2025FactsGrouped with gs.society_name=? AND gs.village_name_key=?; pct per grower_name_key.

rows.name: Root subtext (XK Growers)
rows.description: Grower count shown under root as thousands label.
rows.formula: (kpis.growers / 1000).toFixed(1) + "K Growers"

rows.name: 2025_Indent Qty
rows.description: Grower-level drilldown column sorted by dishonourPct DESC.
rows.formula: IFNULL(ind.indent_qty,0) from growerFactJoinSql per row.

rows.name: 2025_Supply Qty
rows.description: Grower-level drilldown column sorted by dishonourPct DESC.
rows.formula: IFNULL(sup.supply_qty,0); may be null coerced to number.

rows.name: 2025_Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Grower-level drilldown column sorted by dishonourPct DESC.
rows.formula: IFNULL(dh.dishonour_qty,0).

rows.name: Dishonour % (Qty)
rows.description: Grower-level drilldown column sorted by dishonourPct DESC.
rows.formula: CASE WHEN IFNULL(ind.indent_qty,0)>0 THEN IFNULL(dh.dishonour_qty,0)/ind.indent_qty ELSE 0 END

rows.name: Footer Total 2025_Indent Qty
rows.description: Footer aggregate row for grower detail table (filter context totals, not sum of visible page).
rows.formula: tx.indentQty from query2025Facts(ctx) global filter context.

rows.name: Footer Total 2025_Supply Qty
rows.description: Footer aggregate row for grower detail table (filter context totals, not sum of visible page).
rows.formula: tx.supplyQty from query2025Facts(ctx).

rows.name: Footer Total 2025_Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Footer aggregate row for grower detail table (filter context totals, not sum of visible page).
rows.formula: tx.dishonourQty from query2025Facts(ctx).

rows.name: Footer Total Dishonour % (Qty)
rows.description: Footer aggregate row for grower detail table (filter context totals, not sum of visible page).
rows.formula: tx.dishonourPctQty = indentQty ? dishonourQty/indentQty : 0; display (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%".

rows.name: 2025 Dishonour % (Count) (root)
rows.description: Overall dishonour rate using summary-table indent and failure counts rolled up across staff hierarchy.
rows.formula: nestedTree.value = Number((pctRatio(root.dishonourCnt, root.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). rootPct = pctRatio without *100. indentCnt=SUM(no_of_purchy_indent); dishonourCnt=SUM(no_of_indent_failer_purchy) by village then nested.

rows.name: ZONE HEAD node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) at ZONE HEAD hierarchy level. Unassigned when staff mapping missing.
rows.formula: Roll up indent_cnt and dishonour_cnt to node; node.value = Number((pctRatio(node.dishonourCnt, node.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). Sorted by value DESC; Unassigned last.

rows.name: ZONAL MANAGER node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) at ZONAL MANAGER hierarchy level. Unassigned when staff mapping missing.
rows.formula: Roll up indent_cnt and dishonour_cnt to node; node.value = Number((pctRatio(node.dishonourCnt, node.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). Sorted by value DESC; Unassigned last.

rows.name: ZONAL INCHARGE node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) at ZONAL INCHARGE hierarchy level. Unassigned when staff mapping missing.
rows.formula: Roll up indent_cnt and dishonour_cnt to node; node.value = Number((pctRatio(node.dishonourCnt, node.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). Sorted by value DESC; Unassigned last.

rows.name: VILLAGE STAFF node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) at VILLAGE STAFF hierarchy level. Unassigned when staff mapping missing.
rows.formula: Roll up indent_cnt and dishonour_cnt to node; node.value = Number((pctRatio(node.dishonourCnt, node.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). Sorted by value DESC; Unassigned last.

rows.name: VILLAGE_NAME_KEY node value
rows.description: Dishonour % (Count) at VILLAGE_NAME_KEY hierarchy level. Unassigned when staff mapping missing.
rows.formula: Roll up indent_cnt and dishonour_cnt to node; node.value = Number((pctRatio(node.dishonourCnt, node.indentCnt)*100).toFixed(2)). Sorted by value DESC; Unassigned last.

rows.name: Root subtext (XK Growers)
rows.description: Grower count label under root; uses loyalty total not distinct grower count.
rows.formula: (growerCount / 1000).toFixed(1) + "K Growers" where growerCount = SUM(loyalty donut counts).

rows.name: Donut center total growers
rows.description: Center label of loyalty donut chart.
rows.formula: loyaltyTotal = SUM(count) from GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer; display (loyaltyTotal/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 0. Never supplied
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "0. Never supplied" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='0. Never supplied'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 1. Supplied 1 year
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "1. Supplied 1 year" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='1. Supplied 1 year'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 2. Supplied 2 years
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "2. Supplied 2 years" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='2. Supplied 2 years'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 3. Supplied 3 years
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "3. Supplied 3 years" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='3. Supplied 3 years'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 4. Supplied 4 years
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "4. Supplied 4 years" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='4. Supplied 4 years'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: 5. Supplied 5 years
rows.description: Grower count in loyalty bucket "5. Supplied 5 years" as donut segment and legend.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) GROUP BY gs.loyalty_slicer WHERE label='5. Supplied 5 years'; segment arc proportional to count/loyaltyTotal; legend shows (count/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: Variety share (top 5)
rows.description: Each treemap tile shows rounded share of supply-row count among top 5 varieties.
rows.formula: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(varietyname),""),"Unknown") name, COUNT(*) cnt FROM purchy_supply [joined to filtered gs] GROUP BY name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5; share=Math.round((cnt/varietyTotal)*100). Tile also shows count as (cnt/1000).toFixed(1)+"K".

rows.name: Variety row count (top 5)
rows.description: Abbreviated count label on each variety treemap tile.
rows.formula: (Number(cnt)/1000).toFixed(1)+"K" per variety from same top-5 query.

rows.name: Failure %
rows.description: Daily dishonour purchy count as percent of daily indent purchy count across selected date range.
rows.formula: Per date D in [dateFrom,dateTo]: indentCnt=COUNT(*) purchy_indent WHERE DATE(supplydate)=D; dishonourCnt=COUNT(*) purchy_dishonour joined to indent WHERE DATE(purchase_date)=D; pct=pctRatio(dishonourCnt,indentCnt); chart plots (pct*100).toFixed(2). Default range 2025-10-24 to 2026-03-06.

rows.name: Total Purchy
rows.description: Total Purchy per supply centre row.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) indent rows grouped by supplycentrename or villagename within date range on i.supplydate.

rows.name: Dishonour Purchy
rows.description: Dishonour Purchy per supply centre row.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) dishonour rows grouped by same dimension within date range on d.purchase_date.

rows.name: Dishonour %
rows.description: Dishonour % per supply centre row.
rows.formula: pctRatio(dishonourPurchy, totalPurchy); display (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%".

rows.name: Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Dishonour Qty per supply centre row.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(d.mode_qty),0) per group.

rows.name: Total Bond
rows.description: Total Bond per supply centre row.
rows.formula: SUM(gs.total_bond) for distinct growers with indents in date range, grouped by centre/village.

rows.name: Total Supply
rows.description: Total Supply per supply centre row.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(s.netwt),0) per group; supply joined to indent in date range.

rows.name: Total Purchy
rows.description: Total Purchy per village row.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) indent rows grouped by supplycentrename or villagename within date range on i.supplydate.

rows.name: Dishonour Purchy
rows.description: Dishonour Purchy per village row.
rows.formula: COUNT(*) dishonour rows grouped by same dimension within date range on d.purchase_date.

rows.name: Dishonour %
rows.description: Dishonour % per village row.
rows.formula: pctRatio(dishonourPurchy, totalPurchy); display (val*100).toFixed(2)+"%".

rows.name: Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Dishonour Qty per village row.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(d.mode_qty),0) per group.

rows.name: Total Bond
rows.description: Total Bond per village row.
rows.formula: SUM(gs.total_bond) for distinct growers with indents in date range, grouped by centre/village.

rows.name: Total Supply
rows.description: Total Supply per village row.
rows.formula: IFNULL(SUM(s.netwt),0) per group; supply joined to indent in date range.

rows.name: Grand Total Purchy
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: SUM(indentCnt) over failureByDate array.

rows.name: Grand Total Dishonour Purchy
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: SUM(dishonourCnt) over failureByDate.

rows.name: Grand Total Dishonour %
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: pctRatio(SUM(dishonourPurchy), SUM(totalPurchy)).

rows.name: Grand Total Dishonour Qty
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: SUM(dishonourQty) over failureByDate.

rows.name: Grand Total Bond
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: overallBond query SUM(gs.total_bond) for growers with indents in range.

rows.name: Grand Total Supply
rows.description: Shared footer totals row shown under both By Supplycentrename and By Villagename tables.
rows.formula: overallSupply SUM(s.netwt) in date range.

rows.name: 2025_Indent Count
rows.description: Power BI v9 measure implemented in purchyPbiFacts.js / dashboard services.
rows.formula: COUNTROWS(FILTER(Grower_Purchywise_Indent, RELATED(Grower_Summary_Sheet[Grower_Key])))
rows.comparison: Not shown on DigiLog UI as DAX; replicated in SQL/JS

rows.name: 2025_Indent Qty

rows.formula: SUM(Grower_Purchywise_Indent[supllymodeqty]) in filter context
rows.comparison: Not shown on DigiLog UI as DAX; replicated in SQL/JS

rows.description: Power BI v9 measure implemented in purchyPbiFacts.js / dashboard services.
rows.formula: DIVIDE([2025_Dishonour Count],[2025_Indent Count],0)
rows.comparison: Not shown on DigiLog UI as DAX; replicated in SQL/JS

rows.name: 2025_Dishonour % (Qty)
rows.description: Power BI v9 measure implemented in purchyPbiFacts.js / dashboard services.
rows.formula: DIVIDE([2025_Dishonour Qty],[2025_Indent Qty],0)
rows.comparison: Not shown on DigiLog UI as DAX; replicated in SQL/JS

rows.name: Bonded_Growers
rows.description: Power BI v9 measure implemented in purchyPbiFacts.js / dashboard services.
rows.formula: COUNTROWS(Grower_Summary_Sheet) in filter context
rows.comparison: Not shown on DigiLog UI as DAX; replicated in SQL/JS

rows.name: Failure % by Date
rows.description: Power BI v9 measure implemented in purchyPbiFacts.js / dashboard services.
